Top 10 Anime of All Time

Top 10 Anime of All Time

November 8, 2026

Top 10 Anime of All Time

Anime ki top 10 list banana sabse mushkil kaam hai, kyunke har banda apni list ko hi sahi samajhta hai. Maine bhi kaafi sochne ke baad ye list banayi hai. Ho sakta hai aap meri baaton se agree na karein, aur theek hai, comments ya baat cheet isi liye hoti hai. Ye list sirf popularity par nahi hai. Maine dekha ke kaunsa anime dekhne ke baad bhi dimaag mein reh jata hai.


10. Cowboy Bebop

Sabse pehle 1998 ka ye classic. Sirf 26 episodes hain, lekin har episode ka apna mood hai. Spike, Jet, Faye aur Ed ki ye team space mein bounty hunting karti hai, par asal kahani unke guzre hue kal ki hai. Jazz music iska sabse bada hissa hai. Iska end aaj bhi log discuss karte hain. Agar aap anime ko “bachon ka cartoon” samajhte hain, to pehle isi se shuru karein.

9. Naruto

Naruto ko kuch log purana ya “ratta hua” kehte hain, lekin ek poori generation isi se anime mein aayi. Ek akela, tanha ladka jo sabka respect jeetna chahta hai, ye idea hi dil ko lag jata hai. Naruto aur Sasuke ka rishta, Jiraiya ka kirdaar aur Pain wala arc aaj bhi yaad hai. Haan, filler episodes thoda sabr ka imtihan lete hain. Phir bhi iski emotional ahmiyat se inkaar nahi kiya ja sakta.

8. Code Geass

Lelouch ek aisa hero hai jo bilkul hero jaisa nahi hai. Wo sahi maqsad ke liye galat raste chunta hai, aur dekhne wala barabar sochta rehta hai ke ye ladka theek kar raha hai ya nahi. Iska plot twists se bhara hai aur har episode ke end par agla dekhne ka dil karta hai. Mecha aur chess jaisi strategy ka combination bahut kam anime mein dekhne ko milta hai. Iska finale bohot se logon ke liye ek alag hi experience tha.

7. Steins;Gate

Is anime ki shuruaat thodi slow hai, aur main maanta hoon ke pehle kuch episodes mein dil ukhta hai. Lekin sabr karein. Jab time travel ka asal khel shuru hota hai, to ye aapko apni jagah se hilne nahi deta. Okabe ka dard aur uski bebasi dekhne waale ko bhi mehsoos hoti hai. Time travel par bahut kuch bana hai, par itna dil se banaya hua kam hi hai.

6. One Piece

One Piece ke saath problem ye hai ke itne saare episodes dekh kar log shuru hi nahi karte. Mera kehna hai ke ye har ek episode ke laayak hai. Luffy ka sapna, uski crew ke saath dosti, aur har arc mein naye kirdar aur naye jazbaat. Iski duniya itni bari hai ke 25 saal baad bhi nayi lagti hai. Marineford aur Water 7 jaise arcs dekhne ke baad aap samjhenge ke log is show ke itne deewane kyun hain.

5. Vinland Saga

Ye list ka sabse “pakka” anime hai, matlab ye dheere dheere aapke andar utarta hai. Season 1 mein tabahi aur badla hai, aur season 2 mein ek poora alag sawal: kya sach mein ek aisi duniya mumkin hai jahan talwar ki zaroorat na ho? Thorfinn ka safar nafrat se sukoon tak ka hai. Is mein lambi fight scenes ya shor sharaba kam hai, magar jo hai wo dil par asar karta hai.

4. Death Note

Light Yagami aur L ki zehni jang. Ek notebook, ek naam likho aur banda khatam. Ye idea sunne mein simple lagta hai, lekin iski cat-and-mouse game kamal ki hai. Pehla aadha hissa to bilkul perfect hai. Mujhe lagta hai second half thoda kamzor hai, lekin phir bhi ye anime dekhne wale ko sochne par majboor kar deta hai ke insaaf kya hota hai aur kaun tay karta hai.

3. Attack on Titan

Jab ye shuru hua to sab ne socha ke ye bas titans se ladai ki kahani hai. Phir kahani ne aisa mor liya ke sab hairan reh gaye. Eren ka safar, uski soch ka badalna aur duniya ki sachaai, har cheez ne audience ko jhanjhor diya. Isne dikhaya ke “dushman” aur “dost” ki line itni saaf nahi hoti. Iska ending bohot discuss hua, aur kuch log abhi tak naraaz hain, magar mere liye ye ek hi baar mein kahani ko itna bara bana dene ki jurrat thi.

2. Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood

Agar mujhe kisi ek anime ko “perfect” kehna pare to shayad ye hoga. Edward aur Alphonse ki kahani, unki ghalti aur usse sudharne ki koshish. Har kirdar ka apna maqsad hai aur kisi ka bhi kirdar faltu nahi lagta. 64 episodes mein kahani bilkul tight rehti hai, na zyada kheenchi gayi na jaldi khatam ki gayi. Equivalent exchange ka idea aapko kaafi der tak sochne par majboor karta hai.

1. Hunter x Hunter (2011)

Mera number one. Gon ek ladka hai jo apne baap ko dhoondhne nikalta hai, aur ye cheez ek chhote se adventure se shuru hoti hai. Lekin Chimera Ant arc tak pahunchte pahunchte ye anime itna gehra ho jata hai ke aap hairan reh jaate hain. Power system itna samajhdaar hai ke har fight mein dimaag ka istemaal hota hai, sirf taqat ka nahi. Netero aur Meruem ki baat cheet is anime ka sabse yaadgaar hissa hai. Dosti, ghamand, maut aur insaaniyat, sab kuch isme hai.

Aakhri Baat

Ye meri list hai, aur yaqeenan kuch bohot achhe anime reh gaye hain. Neon Genesis Evangelion, Demon Slayer, Jujutsu Kaisen, Your Name, aur bhi kai. Top 10 mein sirf 10 jagah hoti hai, aur ye hi us list ki problem hai. Agar aapne abhi tak inme se kuch nahi dekha, to koi bhi ek utha kar shuru kar dein. Ho sakta hai aapka favourite meri list mein na ho, bas wo mil jaye jo aapko pasand aaye.

Agar aap chahein to main isi article ko English mein ya thoda aur casual tone mein bhi likh sakta hoon, ya aapki marzi ki list ke hisaab se badal sakta hoon.
